purpose: Demonstrate observed-sale-timing as a conditional proxy input to existing Hines SD molecules, not estimate actual unserved demand or cafe capacity
source_input: Pinned GitHub mirror of BreadBasket_DMS.csv processed by breadbasket_analyze.py (source blob SHA-1 ceea9513b75a3dda41a9209b6fd1875c12580933)

scenario_parameters.orders_forcing: 4 * unique POS transaction counts recorded in each 15-minute bin (per hour), held at the start of each time step
scenario_parameters.desired_production_forcing: equal to observed POS forcing; capacity-utilization molecule maps to modeled kitchen output
scenario_parameters.production_feeds_shipping_model: CapUtil.Production -> invbakf.Producing via sampled time-series, no endogenous feedback

provenance.runtime_model_units_relabelled: Widgets->orders, Month/Week->Hour in transient copies only; all Hines mathematical expressions and lookup points unchanged

nonclaims: POS recorded sales are neither unconstrained demand nor customer arrivals
Zero recorded sales does not demonstrate business was open or demand was zero
Capacities and processing/ship times are hypothetical, not estimates
Backlog and prepared inventory are SIMULATED, not observed
Not an identified causal model of the source bakery
No forecast or recommendation about whether to open delivery
